settings.ridge_solver: numpy general LU, primal/dual closed form

pool_story_settings.codes: QR Pascal throughout; P1 for observable integral endpoints
pool_story_settings.raw: total acceleration + body gyro, training-global axis scaling; tensor342 or log171
pool_story_settings.spectral: Five groups, xyz/norm; normalized power; within-channel tensor160/log100 or cross-channel log370
pool_story_settings.log_convention: First levels and antisymmetric level two; constants removed with training mask
pool_story_settings.supplied561: Only the separately evaluated baseline, never appended to any construction here
pool_story_settings.protocol: Existing official subject split, fixed ridge alpha10; exploratory comparisons on the same test set
pool_story_settings.timings: Shared all-family preparation and dense signatures before readout; added integral timings include all lifts

energy_mean.description: Mean of energy observations; constant-code endpoint

energy_second.description: Raw second moment of energy; squared-observable endpoint

energy_std.description: Standard deviation of energy; square root of centered-square endpoint

gram_mean.description: Mean of gram observations; constant-code endpoint

gram_second.description: Raw second moment of gram; squared-observable endpoint

gram_std.description: Standard deviation of gram; square root of centered-square endpoint

cosine_mean.description: Mean of cosine observations; constant-code endpoint

cosine_second.description: Raw second moment of cosine; squared-observable endpoint

cosine_std.description: Standard deviation of cosine; square root of centered-square endpoint

invariant_mean_std.description: Energy, cross-triad Gram and lag-2/5 Gram streams: mean/std; P1 endpoints of centered/standardized observables, with square root for std

invariant_mean_std_skew.description: Energy, cross-triad Gram and lag-2/5 Gram streams: mean/std/skew; P1 endpoints of centered/standardized observables, with square root for std

invariant_mean_std_skew_kurt.description: Energy, cross-triad Gram and lag-2/5 Gram streams: mean/std/skew/kurt; P1 endpoints of centered/standardized observables, with square root for std

triad_mean.description: Body acceleration, gravity and gyro means after training axis scaling

triad_second.description: Body acceleration, gravity and gyro raw second moments after training axis scaling

spectral_amplitude_mean.description: Raw amplitude moment; level-one signature after the stated observable transform

spectral_amplitude_second.description: Raw amplitude moment; level-one signature after the stated observable transform

spectral_amplitude_third.description: Raw amplitude moment; level-one signature after the stated observable transform

spectral_amplitude_fourth.description: Raw amplitude moment; level-one signature after the stated observable transform

spectral_amplitude_std.description: Window-centered amplitude std; square root of centered-square endpoint

spectral_amplitude_skew.description: Window-centered amplitude skew; level-one signature after the stated observable transform

spectral_amplitude_kurtosis.description: Window-centered amplitude kurtosis; level-one signature after the stated observable transform

spectral_log_energy.description: log1p of Parseval energy; nonlinear endpoint readout, not a linear signature coordinate

concentration_q05.description: Sum of normalized spectral bin masses raised to 0.5; power-observable integral, independent of the location of bins

concentration_q15.description: Sum of normalized spectral bin masses raised to 1.5; power-observable integral, independent of the location of bins

concentration_q2.description: Sum of normalized spectral bin masses raised to 2; power-observable integral, independent of the location of bins

concentration.description: Spectral concentration sums for q=0.5, 1.5, 2; q=1 is constant and omitted

energy_cosine_pascal_P3_first.description: Three QR polynomial time moments of three energy and three cross-cosine streams

energy_cosine_pascal_P3_log.description: Within-stream P3 depth-two logsignature: endpoints and orthonormal antisymmetric areas

observable_integrals.normalization: P1 endpoints divided by their actual constant QR code value to recover means
observable_integrals.timings: Block times overlap; all pre-existing family construction is excluded

rotation_moment_grid.groups: all streams; or energy / instantaneous Gram / lag-2,5 Gram / instantaneous+lagged Gram
rotation_moment_grid.reason: Initial run:66-column energy+cosine+amplitude mean/std pool retained97.56% with log/log; test invariant moment additions
